neet_che_u07_t00_1.working: Cu2+ gains 2 electrons and is reduced to Cu, so it is the oxidising agent.

neet_che_u07_t00_2.working: Each Al goes from 0 to +3, losing 3 e-, so 2 mol Al transfer 2 x 3 = 6 mol e-.

neet_che_u07_t00_3.working: A redox couple is written as oxidised/reduced form, giving Fe2+/Fe and Cu2+/Cu.

neet_che_u07_t00_4.working: Mg goes from 0 to +2, losing electrons, so it is the reducing agent and A is true. R is a true general principle, but it does not explain why Mg specifically is the reductant.

neet_che_u07_t00_5.working: Sn2+ goes to Sn4+, losing 2 e-, so it is the reductant and is oxidised. Each Fe3+ gains 1 e-, so 2 Fe3+ gain 2 e- per mole of Sn2+. Both statements are correct.
